source.title: Ocean thermal and current structures in the tropical South Atlantic relative to the placement of a grazing OTEC plant
source.text_extraction: Scanned pages; pypdf did not extract text. Relevant pages read visually from local rendered PNGs.

source_summary: Page 24 attributes a weak surface SECC to Merle (1977), extending eastward from Brazil to a printed 25 degrees N. It describes a 6-10 degrees S band, weakening at 50/75 m and reappearing at 200 m near 5 degrees S. Mazeika (1968) is cited for a core near 150 m at 20 degrees W. These are different depth contexts, not uniform current edges. Figure 11 is a schematic adapted from Defant (1961), without an SECC label.
